name: Chadwick Commons
summary: Chadwick Commons is a neighborhood shopping center in Northlake, Texas, serving the rapidly growing northern Denton County area along Highway 114. Developed by Western Securities, a family-owned company since 1932, the center provides convenient retail and services to local residential communities.
demographics: Chadwick Commons serves the rapidly growing Northlake area in northern Denton County, attracting young families and professionals drawn to the region's new residential developments and proximity to major employment centers. The trade area features above-average household incomes with a mix of first-time homebuyers and move-up buyers seeking newer construction in master-planned communities. Primary shoppers include dual-income households aged 25-45 with children, who value convenience-oriented retail and services for their daily needs and prefer quick-stop shopping experiences close to home.
description: Chadwick Commons is a neighborhood shopping center located in Northlake, Texas, strategically positioned along Texas Highway 114 in one of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex's fastest-growing corridors. Developed and managed by Western Securities, a family-owned real estate company with roots dating back to 1932, this property reflects the company's commitment to long-term value and community-focused development. The center serves the burgeoning residential communities of northern Denton County, providing essential retail and service options to an area experiencing significant population growth. With convenient highway access and ample parking, Chadwick Commons offers a practical shopping destination for local residents seeking everyday conveniences without the drive to larger regional centers. The property benefits from Western Securities' four generations of real estate expertise and their philosophy of strategic development and value-added management, ensuring the center remains well-maintained and responsive to community needs.
